title: Businesses Urged to Prepare for El Niño
description:
As part of the City's broader El Niño preparedness efforts, Economic Development Department teams will be visiting businesses over a span of six weeks in areas with a history of flooding – including Barrio Logan, Encanto, Logan Heights, Southcrest, Pacific Beach, Mission Beach and Ocean Beach – to share tips on how they can prepare. They are also collaborating with business associations to help share emergency and preparedness information. Economic Development Department staff expect to visit approximately 1,500 businesses through October.

Stormwater drainage systems in the public right of way are designed for typical rain events. An excessive amount of rain, especially in a short period of time, could overwhelm the City’s stormwater system and cause flooding. Because these conditions have the potential to impact communities across the city, including some business districts, it is critical to understand the risks and take steps to prepare.
